purpose: Teach: 内戦/銃撃/ラテン語/追い出さ/置き去り/煽っ/潰さ/吸い込ま

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 桜さん、内戦の歴史を論文で扱っていましたね
lines.en: Sakura, your paper dealt with the history of civil war, didn't it?
lines.style: Warm, attentive opening. Gentle confirmation — not testing but genuinely recalling. Steady eye contact, slight lean forward. The tone of a teacher who's actually read the work.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい、銃撃事件の社会学を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes — I focused my paper on the sociology of gun violence.
lines.style: Direct and careful. Slight pause before speaking, choosing precision over speed. Respectful tone but not deferential. Pride in the work underneath the formality.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: ラテン語の語源を論文で扱っていましたね
lines.en: And your paper explored Latin etymology, if I remember correctly?
lines.style: Thoughtful, slightly curious — as if she's genuinely wondering if she's recalling it right. Slower pace. Inviting Sakura to confirm. Warm and unrushed.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい、政争で都を追い出された貴族を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Actually, I wrote about a nobleman exiled from the city through political conflict.
lines.style: Quiet correction, not confrontational. She's offering the real focus. Measured delivery. A slight tightening suggests care about precision — she wants the teacher to understand what the paper actually was.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 被災地に置き去りにされた人々を論文で扱っていましたね
lines.en: Your paper covered people abandoned in disaster zones, correct?
lines.style: Engaged and present. Steady voice, respectful curiosity. Not rushing — giving space for Sakura to respond. Teacher mode: aware and attentive.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい、群衆を煽った独裁者を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes — I examined how a dictator incited mob violence.
lines.style: Measured and grounded. She's correcting the framing again, calmly. There's a small undercurrent of responsibility in how she says this — the subject matter matters to her. No apology, just clarity.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 民主主義が潰された国家を論文で扱っていましたね
lines.en: And finally, your paper dealt with a nation where democracy was destroyed?
lines.style: Reflective, almost provisional — like she's checking in. Slower cadence. Open, genuinely curious how Sakura will respond to this last one. The tone shifts slightly, recognizing weight.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい、ブラックホールに吸い込まれた星の運命を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes — I looked at the fate of a star consumed by a black hole.
lines.style: Steady, almost matter-of-fact finale. A slight pause before beginning. The final answer — delivered with composure. Underneath: perhaps a hint of something knowing or accepting. The conversation lands.
